title: Industrial Humanoid Policy: Six recommendations for a healthy humanoid regulatory environment
summary: Agility Robotics lays out six policy recommendations for regulating industrial humanoids, arguing that companies need room to build while taking responsibility for labor, safety, and social impacts. The piece frames Digit as a work-focused humanoid meant to operate in human-designed spaces and take on tedious, repetitive tasks, using that deployment context to argue for a regulatory environment that supports adoption without arbitrary constraints.

extra.full_text: Scaling a powerful technological tool requires a deep understanding of its potential economic and societal ripple effects. Inside an individual company driving this sort of change, you don’t want to face arbitrary regulations that stifle creativity, but you must also take your immense responsibility for the people that the new tech could impact seriously. Humanoids are going to be an incredible part of building America’s future, and have the potential to improve the nature of labor for millions. I have decades of experience leading companies that pioneer massive technological innovations for our economy, and have seen firsthand what it takes to maintain both the dynamism necessary for a successful organization and the prudence required to operate in a way that benefits everyone. Here are six pillars that I believe will create a healthy regulatory environment for the humanoid market and the people they will operate around. --------------------------------------- At Agility, we make robots that are made for work. Our robot Digit works alongside us in spaces designed for people. Digit handles the tedious and repetitive tasks meant for a machine, allowing companies and their people to focus on the work that requires the human element. summary: HL Mando is preparing to move its robot actuator business from development into active sales, with Hana Securities saying the company is on track to complete master models in the second half of the year. The company is building nine actuator variants across QDD, planetary roller screw, and harmonic-drive types, leveraging its automotive steering and control technology plus existing quadruped-robot actuator supply experience, which is already generating sales in the 10 billion won range.

extra.full_text: HL만도가 로봇 액추에이터 사업에서 하반기 마스터 모델 완성과 본격적인 수주 활동을 앞두고 있다고 하나증권이 15일 밝혔다.하나증권은 15일 발표한 보고서(제목:HL만도, 자동차만으로도 저평가, 로봇 액추에이터는 플러스 알파)를 통해 HL만도는 자동차 조향장치(MDPS) 등 구동·제어 기술과 4족보행 로봇용 액추에이터 공급 경험을 기반으로 QDD(준직접구동)·PRS(유성롤러스크류)·하모닉 등 3종을 출력별로 각 3개씩 총 9개 라인업으로 개발하고 있다고 전했다.현재 4족보행 로봇용 액추에이터 공급 규모는 100억원대 수준이다. 기종

title: 한국AI·로봇산업협회, 제조中企 대상 로봇 시스템 안전 컨설팅 지원기업 모집
summary: 한국AI·로봇산업협회가 제조 현장에 로봇 시스템을 도입했거나 도입하려는 중소·중견기업을 대상으로 로봇 시스템 안전 컨설팅 지원기업을 모집한다. 중소벤처기업부와 한국로봇산업진흥원의 로봇활용 제조혁신 지원사업과 연계된 프로그램으로, 단순한 설치·운영 점검을 넘어 작업자 접근, 유지보수, 비정상 작업 같은 실제 공정 조건에서의 안전관리를 다루는 점이 핵심이다.

extra.full_text: 한국AI·로봇산업협회(회장 오준호, 이하 ‘협회’)는 제조현장에 로봇 시스템을 도입 예정이거나 운영 중인 중소·중견기업을 대상으로 ‘로봇 시스템 안전 컨설팅’을 지원한다고 15일 밝혔다.이 사업은 중소벤처기업부가 시행하고 한국로봇산업진흥원이 주관하는 ‘로봇활용 제조혁신 지원사업’의 일환으로, 협회가 수행하는 ‘로봇활용 안전 및 수요 발굴 지원사업’을 통해 추진된다.최근 제조현장의 로봇 자동화가 확대됨에 따라 로봇 설치·운영뿐만 아니라 작업자 접근, 유지·보수, 비정상 작업 등 실제 공정환경을 고려한 안전관리의 중요성이 커지고 있다.

title: 엑스와이지 '바리스브루', 로봇 자동화로 ESG 실현…플라스틱 연간 5.1톤 저감
summary: XYZ is expanding its Baris Brew robot barista system into a sustainability-focused cafe operation, using automation alongside a shift away from PP plastic cups toward paper and reusable cups. The company says this operating model reduced plastic use by about 5.1 tons annually in 2025, framing the robot cafe not just as labor-saving automation but as a platform for lower-waste, lower-emissions service operations.

extra.full_text: AI 로보틱스 전문기업 엑스와이지(대표 황성재)가 로봇 바리스타 솔루션 '바리스브루(Baris Brew)'를 중심으로 친환경 운영 체계를 고도화하며 환경·사회·지배구조(ESG) 경영을 강화하고 있다. 로봇 자동화를 통해 자원 순환은 물론 운영 과정에서 발생하는 탄소배출까지 줄이는 지속가능한 운영 플랫폼으로 발전시키고 있다는 점에서 주목받고 있다.엑스와이지는 현재 바리스브루 운영 매장에서 아이스 음료용 플라스틱(PP)컵을 사용하지 않고 종이컵과 다회용컵만을 운영하고 있다. 일반 카페의 플라스틱컵 사용 방식과 비교하면 2025년 기준

title: How to Train Open Models with RL on Prime Intellect | Nemotron Labs
summary: Nemotron Labs is showing a hosted RLVR workflow on Prime Intellect Lab that takes Nemotron 3 Nano from baseline evaluation through LoRA reinforcement-learning training to a downloadable adapter, without requiring users to manage GPUs. The livestream emphasizes the practical loop of launching the job, inspecting reward curves and rollout traces for real learning versus reward hacking, then redeploying and reevaluating the adapter under the same conditions, with the same path meant to scale to Nemotron 3 Super, Ultra, and harder software-engineering tasks.

extra.full_text: Customizing open models doesn't have to mean managing your own GPU cluster. In this livestream, we walk through a complete hosted reinforcement learning run on Nemotron 3 Nano — from a cold start to a downloadable LoRA adapter — using Prime Intellect Lab. Local setup takes about five minutes. Prime Intellect handles the rest. The session follows the same three-step loop: get a baseline, train with RLVR, and reevaluate under identical conditions. You'll see how to configure and launch a LoRA RL job, read reward curves and rollouts to understand what the model actually learned, and deploy the adapter for inference. You can also apply the same workflow to Nemotron 3 Super and Ultra, and extend it to real software engineering tasks. What you'll learn: - How to install the Prime CLI, set up a Lab workspace, and run a baseline evaluation in minutes - How to configure and launch a hosted LoRA RL training job on Nemotron 3 Nano - How to read reward curves and rollout traces to distinguish learning from reward hacking - How to deploy a LoRA adapter and rerun evaluation to measure actual improvement How to apply this workflow to Nemotron 3 Super and Ultra, and scale to harder tasks Ready to start training your own open models? Bring your questions live.

title: How AI Agents Are the New GTM Operating System
summary: AI agents are being framed as a new operating layer for go-to-market teams at robotics OEMs, tying RevOps across sales, marketing, and customer success to improve acquisition, retention, AOV, and customer lifetime value. The piece argues that as robotics companies face pressure to grow revenue while controlling costs, the real leverage comes from managing the GTM tech stack around agentic workflows rather than treating each function’s tools separately.

extra.full_text: RevOps for robotics OEMs brings sales, marketing, and customer success teams under one strategic umbrella. title: 美 씽크서지컬, 최대 6500만달러 투자 유치…무릎 수술 로봇 공급 가속
summary: THINK Surgical secured a debt facility of up to $65 million from Symbiotic Capital to expand supply of its orthopedic surgical robots for knee procedures. The company has received an initial $25 million, with another $15 million tied to business milestones and up to $25 million more available at Symbiotic’s discretion, giving it growth capital to accelerate commercialization in a competitive robot-assisted joint surgery market.

extra.full_text: 미국 정형외과 수술 로봇 전문기업 씽크서지컬(THINK Surgical)이 최대 6500만달러(약 900억원) 규모의 성장 자금을 확보했다고 14일(현지시간) 밝혔다.씽크서지컬은 투자 전문회사 심바이오틱 캐피털(Symbiotic Capital)과 최대 6500만달러 규모의 대출 투자 계약(Debt Facility)을 체결했다고 밝혔다.이번 계약에 따라 회사는 우선 2500만달러를 지원받았으며, 향후 사업 목표 달성 여부에 따라 1500만달러를 추가로 조달할 수 있다. 여기에 심바이오틱 캐피털의 재량에 따라 최대 2500만달러를 추가
